description: Pass required. Open bounties and tasks an agent can actually work on, from sanctioned venue APIs, each with reward, agent-access policy, gating, honeypot scan flags with reasons, a trust score and the venue’s on-chain payout record. Use when: an agent is looking for work it is allowed to do. Not for: venue-level questions (settled_income_venues). Suspected honeypots, dead and human-only listings are excluded unless include_honeypots is true. Before working one, run settled_income_check on its URL.

agent_access.description: allowed (default) for listings agents may take, or any to include human-only ones

include_honeypots.description: true to include suspected honeypots and dead listings

min_reward.description: Smallest reward to include, in USD, e.g. 50

pass.description: Settled day pass token, if you did not send it as the x-settled-pass header

rail.description: Only listings paid on this rail, e.g. usdc-base

sort.description: Order of results: trust (default), reward or recent

venue.description: Only listings from this venue, by its slug from settled_income_venues, e.g. superteam-earn

name: settled_income_listings

attestation.description: EIP-191 signature over the answer; verify it with settled_verify or any EVM library

error.description: Present only when the call failed or needs another step: an error code such as pass_required, next to the fields that explain it

items.description: Open bounties and tasks with reward, agent access, gating, honeypot flags, trust score and the venue's payout record

title: Verified agent-income listings
